Yes—it is easy to remove an item from the pile.

Open the focused [Read later view](http://maker:4001/search.html?mode=live&readLater=check&view=later) and uncheck **Read later** on **Making Sense of Color Palettes**.

That card should disappear immediately, leaving only the Kyoto bookmark and changing the count from **2 results** to **1 result**. I’ve verified this exact interaction.
